scientific_integrity: All-primes assertions proved mathematically; exact finite arithmetic checker is only a finite certificate for line-intersection ranks, and finite-field point examples are corroborative. Independent review is absent.
scientific_limitations: Rational Neron-Severi and Frobenius eigenspace classification only; integral saturation and explicit missing-class equations not claimed. Literature priority remains provisional, particularly against general classical Jacobi-sum results.
title: The mod-eight arithmetic Picard diagram of the Fermat quartic and its line-class defect
